name: RAD54 like
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: RAD54L encodes DNA repair and recombination protein RAD54-like. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and DNA translocase activity. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
